name: blender-render
description: Ray-trace molecular structures with PyMOL poses, transparent backgrounds, and textured ribbons.

interface.longDescription: Create ray-traced molecular stills from PSE, CIF, and PDB files. Preserve PyMOL views and colors, use pastel or dried-paint materials, and download transparent PNGs and optional Blender scenes. Connect to the credit-funded service, your Mac, or your lab's compute.
defaultPrompt: Render this structure with a transparent background.
Use dried green paint and rounded ribbons.
Render my saved PyMOL pose and include a Blender file.
